gloss: last place; dead last; the bottom

definitions.gloss: last place; dead last; the bottom; the worst position
definitions.explanation: The very last position in a ranking, race, competition, or group. A casual, somewhat humorous word.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ビリだった。
examples.english: I came in last in the marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ビリだった。
examples.english: My test score was the lowest in the class.

examples.japanese: ビリ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{二番目|にばんめ}→二番目：30362_nibanme⟧だった⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、ビリ⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まし→まし：11145_mashi⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慰|なぐさ}めた→慰める：02133_nagusameru⟧。
examples.english: I was second to last, so I consoled myself that at least it was better than being dead last.

notes:
A casual, colloquial word for being in last place. It has a somewhat lighthearted tone and is commonly used in everyday conversation, especially among children and students.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to come in last
- ビリ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{二番目|にばんめ}→二番目：30362_nibanme⟧: second to last
- ビリ⟦っけ→っけ：10739_kke⟧つ: dead last (slang, emphatic; from ビリ + {尻|けつ} 'butt')
- ⟦{万年|まんねん}→万年：28146_mannen⟧ビリ: perennially last place

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最下位|さいかい}→最下位：20709_saikai⟧: last place — formal equivalent; used in official rankings and sports standings
- ドベ: dead last — dialectal (Nagoya/Kansai area) variant with the same meaning
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: last — broader meaning; can mean 'last' in sequence, not necessarily worst

REGISTER:
Informal and conversational. Not used in formal writing or official contexts. Written in katakana (ビリ).
